$comment: M2. A badge-locked profile (meet_set_profile_lock) seen by a caller whose card is below the lock. The teaser carries photo 0 only and no prompts, bio or daily answer (design §4.2, §6.3); the rest of the card comes through as usual. Unlocking is the privilege to reach, never a guaranteed reply and never a meeting; the copy must say exactly that (ADR-0027). M2-PR8 implements it, and M2-PR12 draws it.

ways.reach_card: Hold a Gold card or higher. The ladder page shows both paths to it: pay up (VIP days or purchased Cowries spent) and play up (level).
ways.unlock: meet_unlock_profile for 30 days. Its cost comes from meet_economy_catalogue().spend_costs, never from this card, and is sent back as p_expected_cost.
ways.reach_request: meet_send_reach_request, offered only when the owner accepts requests. Declining is silent: the sender learns only 'not accepted'.

meet_unlock_profile.note: Every spend returns the wallet so the Cowrie pill can animate the change without a second call. Bonus Cowries are spent first.

storage: Positions 1 and up of a locked profile are excluded from meet_media_visible_to until the caller's card meets the lock or an unlock is active, so fetching them fails like a missing object. The client must not rely on hiding them.

errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PROFILE_LOCKED: Returned only to explain a teaser, for example when meet_get_profile is called on a locked profile. Render the teaser, not an error.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_INSUFFICIENT_COWRIES: Detail {"needed":50,"total":35}. Open the Get Cowries sheet at the smallest pack that covers the shortfall; after a granted purchase, replay the same intent with the same idempotency key.
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_PRICE_CHANGED: The cost changed since the catalogue was read. Nothing was charged: refresh the catalogue and show the new price before trying again (ADR-0026 D18).
errors_a_client_will_see.ERR_MEET_WALLET_RESTRICTED: A negative balance after a refund, or a fraud hold: see negative-balance.json.
